title: Is xdrip+ working with Libre2 and mioamioa1 or miaomiao2?
body:
Hi,
found a lot of confusing infos, whether xdrip+ is working with Libre2 using mioamiao2(patched) or new miaomiao2?
Is it or not?
And if it is: Whats the correct configuration?
Always get a "No sensor has been found" using datasource "libre wifi".
Thanks for a hint.

comments.body: You should choose "Libre Bluetooth" in Hardware Data Source, if you are using MM with Libre...

@Strukturo Would you please close this issue if you have got the answers you were looking for?
Otherwise, you can use the xDrip facebook group or Gitter room.
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5
https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus
Thanks
